title: Crystal Skulls: What the Evidence Says About Their Age
excerpt: Two of the best-known crystal skulls were tested with a microscope and archive research in 2008. What the tool marks, the quartz and the paper trail show.

meta.advanced_seo_description: Are crystal skulls ancient? A 2008 British Museum and Smithsonian study of tool marks, quartz and archives on two famous skulls, and what it does not cover.
